lines.en: label slumberreset2:
scene sky
I spend a good thirty minutes or so attempting to get acquainted with the area surrounding my new apartment and quickly find that I have absolutely no idea where I am.
lines.zh: 我花了大概三十分钟，想熟悉一下新公寓周边的环境，很快就发现我完全不知道自己在哪儿。

lines.en: What complicates things even further is the fact that my phone, which had just enough battery left to call Maya a short while ago, is now completely dead.
lines.zh: 更麻烦的是，我的手机——刚才还剩一点电，够我给 Maya 打个电话——现在已经彻底没电了。

lines.en: Thankfully, after aimlessly wandering the streets in hope of stumbling across a station (Or even somewhere I could charge my phone), I come across an empty bus stop and decide to wait there.
lines.zh: 所幸，在街上漫无目的地乱走、希望能撞见一个车站（或者随便一个能充电的地方）之后，我遇到了一个空荡荡的公交站，决定在那儿等。

lines.en: I have no way of knowing when the next bus will arrive or where it will be headed when it gets here, but I figure that relying on public transportation is a lot smarter than leaving things to my intuition.
lines.zh: 我无从知道下一班车什么时候来、来了之后又会开往哪里，但我觉得依赖公共交通比靠直觉聪明得多。

lines.en: Especially when my intuition has a tendency of leading me into the bedrooms of high school girls who then proceed to take their clothes off.
lines.zh: 尤其是我的直觉总喜欢把我领进高中女生的卧室，然后她们就开始脱衣服。

lines.en: I imagine this bus (If it ever comes) will not be so convenient.
lines.zh: 我想这辆巴士（如果它真的会来的话）不会那么方便。

lines.en: But, on the off chance it is, I will know for certain that I am {b}GOD{/b} and that everything in the entire universe revolves around my penis.
lines.zh: 不过万一它真的那么方便，我就能确定自己是 {b}神{/b}，整个宇宙都围着我的鸡巴转。

lines.en: scene black
scene mayanebench1
I eventually {i}do{/i} make it to the park I agreed to meet Maya in, albeit {i}significantly{/i} behind schedule- which may or may not explain why a certain someone else is now here as well.
lines.zh: 我最终{i}确实{/i}到了跟 Maya 约好的公园，尽管比约定时间晚了{i}相当多{/i}——这大概也能解释，为什么某个人现在也在这儿。

lines.en: : Hey...surprise.
lines.zh: : 嘿……惊喜吧。

lines.en: : Surprise indeed.
lines.zh: : 确实是惊喜。

lines.en: : Should I go? When Maya told me you called her, I kind of figured that you wanted this to be a thing for just you and her, but...she was suspiciously insistent that I come as well.
lines.zh: : 我要不要走？Maya 告诉我你给她打电话的时候，我本来以为你想让这事只属于你和她，不过……她异常坚持要我也来。

lines.en: scene mayanebench2
: Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: I attempt to look at Maya for confirmation and, despite her turning away immediately, I receive it.
lines.zh: 我试图看向 Maya 求证，尽管她立刻转开了脸，我还是得到了确认。

lines.en: : We were already together. I would have felt bad just leaving Ayane behind.
lines.zh: : 我们本来就在一起。把 Ayane 一个人丢下，我会过意不去。

lines.en: : Since when do you feel bad for literally anyone other than yourself? In fact, I’m pretty sure you’re on record openly admitting to wanting to leave Ayane permanently behind to at least {i}some{/i} extent.
lines.zh: : 你从什么时候开始会为除自己以外的任何人过意不去了？事实上，我很确定你曾经公开承认过，至少在{i}某种{/i}程度上想把 Ayane 永远丢下。

lines.en: : That is a skewed, yet mildly accurate generalization of things I may have said in the past, yes.
lines.zh: : 这是对我过去可能说过的话的一种歪曲、但还算有点准确的概括，是的。

lines.en: : But given recent circumstances, I may or may not be currently attempting to be a bit more...{i}careful{/i} with my decisions.
lines.zh: : 不过考虑到最近的状况，我可能、也可能没有在尝试对自己的决定更……{i}小心{/i}一点。

lines.en: : Did you happen to tell Ayane what those {i}circumstances{/i} are as well?
lines.zh: : 那你有没有把那些{i}状况{/i}也告诉 Ayane？

lines.en: : She...didn’t need to. I more or less pieced things together when Ami and I ran into her last night. It was the first time I’ve ever seen Maya look that-
lines.zh: : 她……不需要。昨晚我和 Ami 撞见她的时候，我差不多把事情拼出来了。那是我第一次看到 Maya 露出那种-

lines.en: scene mayanebench3
: Unfazed and disinterested? Why yes, I believe I {i}may{/i} have looked like that last night. Thank you for remembering, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 无动于衷、漠不关心？哎呀，对，我相信我昨晚{i}也许{/i}就是那个样子。谢谢你还记得，Ayane。

lines.en: : We really should talk alone for at least-
lines.zh: : 我们真的该单独谈谈，至少-

lines.en: scene mayanebench4
: We most assuredly {i}will{/i} talk alone as the world seems to have no issue whatsoever in regard to forcing the two of us together. I just don't want to do that {i}right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们{i}当然会{/i}单独谈，毕竟这个世界似乎一点都不介意硬把我和你凑到一起。我只是{i}现在{/i}不想谈。

lines.en: : But fear not, you’ll have plenty more opportunities to torment me in the future.
lines.zh: : 不过别担心，以后你有的是机会折磨我。

lines.en: : For now, there are much more {i}important{/i} matters we need to discuss.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们有更{i}重要{/i}的事情要讨论。

lines.en: : I see. I guess I should have figured you’d fall back on your tsun side for safety after last night.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。我应该想到，经过昨晚之后，你会退回到傲娇那一面求安全。

lines.en: scene mayanebench5
: Call me {i}tsun{/i} again and-
lines.zh: : 再叫我一次{i}傲娇{/i}我就-

lines.en: : Sensei...can {i}you{/i} tell me what happened? Specifically, I mean.
lines.zh: : Sensei……{i}你{/i}能告诉我发生了什么吗？我是说，具体一点。

lines.en: : Have you not already learned enough?
lines.zh: : 你不是已经知道得够多了吗？

lines.en: scene mayanebench6
: Enough about what? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 知道什么够了？你这是什么意思？

lines.en: : Just...some bet we had.
lines.zh: : 只是……我们之间的一个赌注。

lines.en: : You know I wouldn’t be mad at either one of you if you decided to...really start showing each other just how much you-
lines.zh: : 你知道的，如果你们俩决定……真的开始向对方展示你们有多-

lines.en: scene mayanebench7
: Can we {i}please{/i} not? I still have no idea where I’d even start and-
lines.zh: : 能{i}别{/i}说了吗？我连该从哪儿说起都不知道，而且-

lines.en: : Maya and I almost kissed.
lines.zh: : Maya 和我差点接吻了。

lines.en: scene mayanebench8
: What? That’s {i}it?{/i}
lines.zh: : 什么？就{i}这样{/i}？

lines.en: : Yup.
: So...you two {i}didn’t{/i} kiss...and you need to talk about it?
lines.zh: : 所以……你们俩{i}没有{/i}接吻……然后你们还要谈这个？

lines.en: : No. We don’t.
lines.zh: : 不。我们不需要。

lines.en: : We do.
lines.zh: : 我们需要。

lines.en: : Huh...I really don’t know the first thing about your relationship, do I?
lines.zh: : 哈……我对你俩的关系真是一点都不了解，是吧？

lines.en: : Cause you and I have had sex probably a million times and you’ve never tried setting up a meeting like this with {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为我跟你大概做过一百万次爱，而你从来没有为{i}我{/i}安排过这样的会面。

lines.en: scene mayanebench9
: Okay, Ayane. You can go now. I suddenly realize how much of a mistake it was allowing you to tag along for this.
lines.zh: : 好了，Ayane。你可以走了。我突然意识到，让你跟着来是个多大的错误。

lines.en: : It’s {i}because{/i} of how things are with Maya and me that we need to talk about it. Kind of like how {i}not{/i} having sex with you anymore is a thing we’re both struggling with.
lines.zh: : {i}正因为{/i}我和 Maya 之间是这样，我们才需要谈。就像{i}不再{/i}跟你做爱，是我们俩都在挣扎的事。

lines.en: : Oh, you poor souls. How ever have you managed to make it a full {i}several months{/i} without such contact?
lines.zh: : 哦，你们这对可怜人。整整{i}好几个月{/i}没有这种接触，你们是怎么熬过来的？

lines.en: scene mayanebench10
: I have no clue. But I hope that you know I am never doing this again as soon as we prove that I can hang with the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad without having a baby inside of me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。但我希望你知道，一旦我们证明了我不肚子里没孩子也能跟「屋顶末日小队」混在一起，我就再也不会干这种事了。

lines.en: : Good. There. {i}That{/i} should be the topic for today’s conversation. {i}Not{/i} me almost kissing the world’s worst teacher and {i}not{/i} you two {i}not{/i} having sex with one another.
lines.zh: : 很好。就这个。{i}那{/i}才是今天该谈的话题。{i}不是{/i}我差点吻了全世界最烂的老师，也{i}不是{/i}你俩{i}没有{/i}做爱。

lines.en: scene mayanebench11
: Not...{i}not{/i} having sex with each other...So what I’m hearing is it’s okay if we talk about doing it?
lines.zh: : 没有……{i}没有{/i}做爱……所以我的理解是，我们聊聊做爱的事是可以的？

lines.en: : Absolutely not and shut up.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行，闭嘴。

lines.en: : You realize you did this to yourself by bringing her here, right?
lines.zh: : 你意识到这是你自找的吧，是你把她带来的？

lines.en: : Like I said, we were already together. It’s not like I would have asked her to come if you’d called me while I was alone.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我们本来就在一起。你要是在我一个人的时候打给我，我也不会叫她来。

lines.en: : Well, why were you together?
lines.zh: : 那你们为什么在一起？

lines.en: : Because we’re friends and that’s what friends do?
lines.zh: : 因为我们是朋友，朋友不就是这样吗？

lines.en: : Sure, yeah...but you’ve seemed to be at odds with one another lately over all of the reset business and your, you know, {i}”not wanting Ayane to be a part of it”{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : 当然，是……不过你们最近似乎因为重置的事、还有你那个，你知道的，{i}「不想让 Ayane 参与进来」{/i}而闹别扭。

lines.en: scene mayanebench12
: That’s still true...and neither one of us has really changed our positions on the matter. Nor do I think we’re going to due to the type of people we are.
lines.zh: : 那依然是真的……而且我们俩在这件事上的立场都没有真正改变过。鉴于我们是这种人，我也不觉得会改变。

lines.en: : We talked about it during Halloween for a little while...and then again this morning. But no matter what Maya wants to happen to me and no matter how much that hurts, she’s still an important part of my life.
lines.zh: : 万圣节那次我们聊了一会儿……今天早上又聊了一次。但不管 Maya 想让什么事发生在我身上、不管那有多伤人，她依然是我生命里重要的一部分。

lines.en: : And if she’s going through something hard, she should have someone there for her. Even if she doesn’t want to admit that she needs it.
lines.zh: : 而如果她正在经历什么难事，她身边该有个人。哪怕她不愿承认自己需要。

lines.en: : Are we done being cute now? Can I rejoin the conversation?
lines.zh: : 我们卖萌卖完了吗？我可以重新加入对话了吗？

lines.en: scene mayanebench13
: Yes, Maya. You may now proceed with your boring timey-wimey stuff.
lines.zh: : 可以，Maya。你现在可以继续讲你那无聊的时间循环话题了。

lines.en: : Excellent, because now that the prolonged and nauseating pleasantries are out of the way, I’d like to announce that we are on the brink of yet another field trip for the “Rooftop Apocalypse Squad.”
lines.zh: : 太好了，既然这冗长又让人反胃的客套已经结束，我想宣布：「屋顶末日小队」又要迎来一次实地考察了。

lines.en: : I’m glad that name stuck. I like it.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴这个名字留下来了。我喜欢。

lines.en: : We should make shirts.
lines.zh: : 我们该做队服。

lines.en: : Already? Isn’t it a little too soon?
lines.zh: : 已经？是不是有点太早了？

lines.en: scene mayanebench14
: It’s never too soon for shirts.
lines.zh: : 做队服永远不嫌早。

lines.en: : For the reset, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我说的是重置，Ayane。

lines.en: : Not really. We {i}did{/i} lose nearly two months of time during the jump from Halloween to Christmas, remember?
lines.zh: : 也不算早。我们从万圣节跳到圣诞节的时候，可是{i}丢了{/i}将近两个月的时间，记得吗？

lines.en: : I’d say we’re right on schedule but, with the lack of an {i}actual schedule{/i}, having a reset now seems like a decent approximation that’s well in-line with the rate things normally move at.
lines.zh: : 我会说我们正好赶得上，不过既然没有{i}真正的日程表{/i}，现在来一次重置倒算是个不错的近似值，跟事情正常推进的速率也挺吻合。

lines.en: : How do you even know, by the way? Do you, like...feel something?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，你是怎么知道的？你，比如说……能感觉到什么吗？

lines.en: scene mayanebench15
: I...guess so? It’s kind of hard to describe.
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧？这有点难形容。

lines.en: : I kind of just know when they’re around the corner. Call it intuition based on iteration after iteration after iteration after-
lines.zh: : 我就是隐约知道它们什么时候快到了。算是一次又一次又一次的迭代积累出的直觉吧，一次又-

lines.en: : So...do we have a plan? Is there something we can do to, like...prepare for it?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们有计划吗？有什么能让我们，比如说……做点准备的事？

lines.en: : There is...something I had in mind. It came to me between the various downward spirals I endured last night.
lines.zh: : 有……我心里有个想法。是我在昨晚经历的各式各样的情绪崩塌之间冒出来的。

lines.en: : And that is?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？

lines.en: scene mayanebench16
: You said that both Yumi and Tsuneyo showed signs of understanding that time isn’t exactly as it seems, correct?
lines.zh: : 你说过 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 都表现出了「察觉到时间并不像看上去那样」的迹象，对吧？

lines.en: : Is that true? Why {i}those{/i} two?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么{i}偏偏是她们俩{/i}？

lines.en: : I have no idea, but yes. Yumi seems more conscious of it than Tsuneyo does, though.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，不过是的。只是 Yumi 似乎比 Tsuneyo 更有意识一些。

lines.en: : Conscious enough to endure a bit of a trial?
lines.zh: : 清醒到足以承受一点考验？

lines.en: : What sort of trial, exactly?
lines.zh: : 什么样的考验？

lines.en: : Do you think she’d listen if we were to sit down and attempt to explain things to her?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，如果我们坐下来试着跟她解释，她会听吗？

lines.en: : Does Yumi even {i}have{/i} the ability to listen?
lines.zh: : Yumi 还有{i}听{/i}人说话的能力吗？

lines.en: : When she wants to, she does. Unfortunately, that doesn’t happen very often.
lines.zh: : 她想听的时候有。不幸的是，那种时候并不常见。

lines.en: : But, given her reaction when I brought things up last night, I’m sure she could spare some time to hear whatever it is you have to say.
lines.zh: : 不过，考虑到昨晚我提起这些事时她的反应，我敢肯定她能抽出点时间听你要说什么。

lines.en: : And Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 那 Tsuneyo 呢？

lines.en: : Just tell her there will be soup and she’ll show up. She’s easy.
lines.zh: : 告诉她有汤喝，她就会来。她很好搞定。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m not telling her anything. You are. Same with Yumi.
lines.zh: : 哦，我可什么都不会跟她说。你去。Yumi 也一样。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene mayanebench17
: Hold on...I thought you said you’ve tried talking to people about this before? Why are you suddenly changing your mind?
lines.zh: : 等等……你不是说你以前试过跟人谈这些吗？为什么突然改主意了？

lines.en: : Because none of the people I’ve ever talked to about it showed any underlying signs of...contemplating the world’s fuckery.
lines.zh: : 因为我以前谈过的那些人，没有一个表现出任何……在思考这个世界的操蛋之处的迹象。

lines.en: : If Yumi and Tsuneyo are already clued in to some extent, perhaps they’d be more inclined to listen rather than immediately switching the topic like everyone else always does.
lines.zh: : 如果 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 已经在某种程度上察觉了，也许她们会更愿意听，而不是像其他人那样立刻岔开话题。

lines.en: : At the very least, it’s worth an attempt. I’m just not sure what we’d do {i}after{/i} we talk to them about it. And by “we” I mean Sensei since I don’t really like talking to either one of them.
lines.zh: : 至少值得一试。我只是不确定跟她们谈完{i}之后{/i}我们要做什么。而这里的「我们」指的是 Sensei，因为我实在不喜欢跟她们俩任何一个说话。

lines.en: scene mayanebench18
: Wait! I know what we can do!
lines.zh: : 等等！我知道我们能做什么！

lines.en: : You do?
lines.zh: : 你知道？

lines.en: : Yeah! And it’s a super great idea! But you’ve gotta hear me out.
lines.zh: : 对！而且是个超棒的主意！但你们得听我把话说完。

lines.en: : Is that...not what I'm already doing?
lines.zh: : 这……不就是我正在做的事吗？

lines.en: : The three of us...as well as Yumi and Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: : 我们三个……还有 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo……

lines.en: scene mayanebench19
: Will have a slumber party.
lines.zh: : 来办个睡衣派对。

lines.en: : You can’t be serious...
lines.zh: : 你不是认真的吧……

lines.en: : Oh, I am super serious.
lines.zh: : 哦，我超级认真。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane-

lines.en: scene mayanebench20
: Just think about it! If we’re all in one place, we can keep an eye on one another in the event that everyone disappears again!
lines.zh: : 你想想看！如果我们都在同一个地方，万一大家又消失了，我们就能互相照应！

lines.en: : The only issue is that we don’t specifically know what {i}day{/i} it will happen, do we?
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，我们并不知道这具体会发生在{i}哪一天{/i}，对吧？

lines.en: : There are many, {i}many{/i} more issues than just that, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 问题可{i}远不止{/i}这一个，Ayane。

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如什么？

lines.en: : I’m debating whether or not I should tell you or just let you see for yourself.
lines.zh: : 我在犹豫，是该告诉你，还是让你自己去看。

lines.en: : If what Maya’s told me is true, it’s not exactly a good sight watching everyone around you “disappear.”
lines.zh: : 如果 Maya 告诉我的都是真的，看着身边的人一个个「消失」可不是什么好景象。

lines.en: scene mayanebench21
: Is there more to it than just literally disappearing?
lines.zh: : 除了字面上消失之外，还有别的吗？

lines.en: : Very. I’m basically desensitized to it by now but, if you’re willing to give it a shot and don’t mind seeing something you will very likely never forget unless you’re fully reset, fine. We can have a “slumber party.”
lines.zh: : 多了去了。我现在基本已经麻木了，不过如果你愿意试一试、也不介意看到某种你很可能永远不会忘记的画面（除非你被完全重置），那行。我们可以办个「睡衣派对」。

lines.en: : But good luck trying to get Yumi and Tsuneyo to agree to it. And good luck finding a place to actually have it since getting Ami involved is basically asking to be cut off from engaging in any real conversation.
lines.zh: : 不过想让 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 同意，祝你好运。还有，想找个真正能办派对的地方也祝你好运，因为把 Ami 卷进来基本等于主动放弃任何真正的对话。

lines.en: scene mayanebench22
: I’d say we can use my house, but I know for a fact Geoffrey wouldn’t let me have a sleepover with Sensei. He’s been very protective ever since Todd disappeared.
lines.zh: : 我倒想说可以用我家，但我很确定 Geoffrey 不会让我跟 Sensei 一起过夜。自从 Todd 失踪之后，他一直特别护着我。

lines.en: : But yeah...getting Yumi and Tsuneyo to agree to something like that does sound hard when we’re not really close to them.
lines.zh: : 不过是啊……既然我们跟她们也不算亲近，想让 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 答应这种事听起来确实挺难的。

lines.en: : I’m not really close to them either, but...I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 我跟她们也不算亲近，不过……我看看能做什么。

lines.en: scene mayanebench23
: Will you find us a place to sleep as well? Preferably one we don’t have to pay for since I am currently broke and Ayane’s card is being declined everywhere.
lines.zh: : 你会不会也顺便给我们找个睡觉的地方？最好是不用花钱的，因为我现在身无分文，而 Ayane 的卡到处都被拒。

lines.en: : Yup! Turns out that while the three of us were being tossed through time, my credit card was being tossed through every single terminal in Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 没问题！原来在我们三个被时间抛来抛去的时候，我的信用卡正在 Kumon-mi 的每一台终端上被刷来刷去！

lines.en: : I’m cut off from spending anything until next month when the bank sorts everything out.
lines.zh: : 在银行把一切处理完之前，下个月之前我都不能花钱了。

lines.en: : Wonderful. That extremely inconvenient coincidence is basically forcing me to reveal something I was {i}hoping{/i} I’d be able to keep quiet for a full twenty-four hours. But fuck me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好极了。这个极其不方便的巧合，基本上逼得我必须公开一件我{i}本来希望{/i}能保密整整二十四小时的事。不过，操我吧，我想。

lines.en: : I would if I could, Sensei. I would if I could.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊，Sensei。我也想。

lines.en: : And what exactly do you have to reveal? A second home that none of us know about?
lines.zh: : 那你到底要公开什么？一套我们谁都不知道的第二套房子？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Funny. What {i}actually{/i} is it?
lines.zh: : 真好笑。{i}到底{/i}是什么？

lines.en: : A second home that none of you know about.
lines.zh: : 一套你们谁都不知道的第二套房子。

lines.en: scene mayanebench24
: What? When? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？什么时候？为什么？

lines.en: : Wait a minute...who drew your name for Secret Santa this year?
lines.zh: : 等等……今年 Secret Santa 抽到你名字的是谁？

lines.en: : Touka.
lines.zh: : Touka。

lines.en: scene mayanebench25
: Mystery solved. Detective Ayane has successfully closed another case.
lines.zh: : 谜团解开。侦探 Ayane 又成功破了一案。

lines.en: : She got you a {i}house?{/i}
lines.zh: : 她送你一套{i}房子{/i}？

lines.en: : An apartment, technically. And you two are now the only people who know about it other than her and Makoto.
lines.zh: : 严格来说是套公寓。而现在除了她和 Makoto，就只有你们两个知道这件事。

lines.en: : Wow. And I thought my cube-shaped watermelon was a good present.
lines.zh: : 哇。我还以为我那个方西瓜已经算不错的礼物了。

lines.en: : So...what then? You’re just going to lure two girls you’re not particularly close with to a secret apartment and keep them there until the world breaks?
lines.zh: : 那么……然后呢？你打算把两个跟你并不算亲近的女孩骗到一套秘密公寓里，把她们扣在那儿直到世界崩坏？

lines.en: : Up until last night, I would have said that scenario sounds more plausible than the two of us kissing. And yet...
lines.zh: : 直到昨晚为止，我本来会说这种情况听起来比我们俩接吻还要可信。然而……

lines.en: scene mayanebench26
: {i}Please{/i} stop bringing that up...
lines.zh: : {i}拜托{/i}别再提那件事了……

lines.en: : What are we going to do about Ami? If all three of us leave her alone, she might explode. In fact, she might be exploding right now and none of us would even know.
lines.zh: : Ami 怎么办？要是我们三个都把她一个人丢下，她可能会爆炸。事实上，她可能现在正在爆炸，而我们谁都不知道。

lines.en: : I’ll think of something for Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami 的事我会想办法……

lines.en: : For now, we need to focus on getting the other two girls on board.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们需要集中精力让另外两个女孩入伙。

lines.en: : I’m not sure how many nights we have left, so it’s important we figure this out as soon as possible or we’ll run the risk of their minds getting wiped along with their...potential recognition of the loops.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我们还剩多少个夜晚，所以我们得尽快搞定，否则她们的记忆很可能连同……她们对循环的潜在认知一起被抹掉。

lines.en: : I’d contact one of them right now, but my phone’s dead.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想现在就联系其中一个，可我手机没电了。

lines.en: scene mayanebench27
: Here. Take this one.
lines.zh: : 给。拿这个。

lines.en: : I’m not going to just take your phone, Ayane. Even if it {i}is{/i} a backup and you have ten more of them in your dorm room.
lines.zh: : 我不会就这么拿走你的手机，Ayane。就算它{i}只是{/i}个备用机，而你宿舍里还有十台。

lines.en: : It’s not just a “backup.” It’s an identical, up-to-date copy of your phone. Complete with all of your contacts and a suggestive picture of our class representative with a vibrator in her mouth.
lines.zh: : 它不只是「备用」。它是你手机的完全相同的、最新的复制品。里面有你全部的联系人，还有一张我们班长含着振动棒的照片。

lines.en: : Why {i}that{/i} is your background and not me, I don’t know. And I don’t {i}want{/i} to know.
lines.zh: : 为什么{i}那个{/i}成了你的壁纸而不是我，我不知道。而我{i}也{/i}不想知道。

lines.en: : Well, speak for yourself because {i}I{/i} would like to know why you have an identical copy of my phone including but not limited to my contacts and Makoto wallpaper.
lines.zh: : 那你自己说吧，{i}我{/i}倒是想知道，为什么你会有我手机的完全复制品，包括但不限于我的联系人和 Makoto 壁纸。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I get bored and send myself text messages from fake-you while waiting for real-you to text me instead.
lines.zh: : 有时候我闲得无聊，会用「假你」给自己发短信，等着「真你」来发。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane-

lines.en: : I have a problem. I know. But at least that problem is love and not drugs.
lines.zh: : 我有病。我知道。但至少这病叫爱，不是毒品。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Oh, and in case you were wondering, I don’t have any of your text or call records. Apparently, having those copied as well would have been an invasion of privacy and is against the law.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果你想知道的话，我没有你的短信和通话记录。显然，连那些一起复制会侵犯隐私，而且是违法的。

lines.en: : I think my privacy has already been invaded, but thanks. I’ll be taking that now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的隐私已经被侵犯过了，不过还是谢谢你。这个我现在拿走了。

lines.en: scene mayanebench28
: Happy to help! And don’t worry about giving it back. I have three more at home.
lines.zh: : 乐意效劳！别担心还不还。我家里还有三台。

lines.en: : That’s...great.
lines.zh: : 那……真是太好了。

lines.en: : Well...good luck, I guess? You’re very likely going to need it.
lines.zh: : 那么……祝你好运？你很可能需要。

lines.en: : Be in touch after you hear back from Yumi and Tsuneyo. Like Maya said, the sooner we can get them on board, the better.
lines.zh: : Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 那边有消息之后就联系我们。就像 Maya 说的，越早让她们入伙越好。

lines.en: : Also, maybe...don’t look at any of the messages that phone has sent to my number. I’ve been going kind of crazy these past few months in more ways than I’d like to admit.
lines.zh: : 还有，也许……别去看那台手机发给我号码的任何消息。这几个月来我在某些方面有点失控，失控到我自己都不太愿意承认。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 我尽力，Ayane……

lines.en: scene black
scene mayanebench29

I get a safe distance away from Maya and Ayane before unlocking my “new” phone with, you guessed it, the same exact passcode I use for my {i}real{/i} phone before making sure all of my contacts are there.
lines.zh: 我走到离 Maya 和 Ayane 足够安全的距离，解锁了我那台「新」手机——你猜对了，用的就是我{i}真{/i}手机那个一模一样的密码——然后确认我的联系人都在。

lines.en: Worryingly, they are. And while I’m extremely concerned as to how Ayane got her hands on my data in the first place, I don’t really have time for that right now.
lines.zh: 令人不安的是，它们都在。虽然我非常想知道 Ayane 到底是怎么弄到我数据的，但我现在真的没时间管这个。

lines.en: If the next reset really is as close as Maya says, I need to act quickly.
lines.zh: 如果下一次重置真的像 Maya 说的那么近，我需要尽快行动。

lines.en: So, without a clear idea in mind about {i}what{/i} I’m going to say when I call...I scroll through a list of names and wind up landing on-
lines.zh: 所以，在脑子里对打电话时该{i}说{/i}什么毫无头绪的情况下，我划过一串名字，最后停在-
